description: How a chosen sort key pairs with a direction, and which catalog path each (key, direction) label reads from — written once per shell because each menu is native. The ORDER ITSELF is not duplicated: every shell asks the Rust store (ADR-0001, vault::note_list_order) and splices engine-reported positions verbatim.
note: Three copies of a two-row table, each with its own unit test asserting the same pairs. Nothing keeps them identical — change one and change all three in the same commit. Collapse candidate: a fourth generated spec alongside gen-title-spec.ts / gen-toolbar-spec.ts, which already emit exactly this class of constant into TitleSpec.swift/.kt. Better still, delete two of the four functions by having the shells send a delta (set the key / set the direction) and letting the store compose it against its own current order.
